rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for movement upward, including toward the sky.

example.jyutping: zek3 fung1 zang1 maan6 maan2 hoeng3 soeng6 fei1

rows.note: Use this when you want to make the skyward direction explicit rather than merely saying upward.

example.english: The fireworks shot skyward as soon as they were launched.
example.traditional: 煙花一放就向住天空升上去。
example.jyutping: jin1 faa1 jat1 fong3 zau6 hoeng3 zyu6 tin1 hung1 sing1 soeng5 heoi3
